Gym.Title: Centurion Iron Regiment (Gym Program)
Gym.Rationale: Hypertrophy & strength progression leveraging progressive overload, compound multi-joint movements, and targeted hypertrophy accessories.

Days3.DayTitle: Day I: Push & Core (Chest, Shoulders, Triceps)
Days3.Warmup: 5 min dynamic mobility: arm swings, band pull-aparts & push-up warmups
Days3.Cooldown: 5 min chest doorway stretch & triceps overhead stretch

Exercises.Name: Barbell / Dumbbell Bench Press
Exercises.FormCue: Retract scapulae, touch lower chest, press with intent

Exercises.Name: Incline Dumbbell Press
Exercises.FormCue: Set bench to 30 degrees, full stretch at bottom

Exercises.Name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
Exercises.FormCue: Core braced, elbows slightly tucked at 45 degrees

Exercises.Name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
Exercises.FormCue: Lead with elbows, slight forward lean, control the drop

Exercises.Name: Triceps Rope Pushdowns
Exercises.FormCue: Elbows pinned to sides, spread rope at lockout

Exercises.Name: Hanging Knee Raises / Cable Crunch
Exercises.FormCue: Curl pelvis upwards, exhale on contraction

Days3.DayTitle: Day II: Pull & Posterior Chain (Back, Rear Delts, Biceps)
Days3.Warmup: 5 min cat-cow, dead hangs & light lat pulldowns
Days3.Cooldown: 5 min lat foam roll & seated hamstring stretch

Exercises.Name: Lat Pulldowns (or Neutral Grip Pull-ups)
Exercises.FormCue: Drive elbows straight down to hips, squeeze lats

Exercises.Name: Chest-Supported Barbell / Dumbbell Row
Exercises.FormCue: Pull to lower ribs, hold squeeze for 1 second

Exercises.Name: Face Pulls with Rope
Exercises.FormCue: Pull rope to eye level, rotate external shoulders

Exercises.Name: Standing Incline Dumbbell Bicep Curls
Exercises.FormCue: Full elbow extension at bottom, rotate pinky up

Exercises.Name: Hammer Curls
Exercises.FormCue: Neutral palms, controlled tempo without swinging

Days3.DayTitle: Day III: Legs, Quads & Glute Armor
Days3.Warmup: 5 min bodyweight squats, hip openers & leg swings
Days3.Cooldown: 5 min quad couch stretch & pigeon pose

Exercises.Name: Barbell Back Squat / Goblet Squat
Exercises.FormCue: Knees track over toes, break parallel with upright chest

Exercises.Name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell or Barbell)
Exercises.FormCue: Hinge at hips, push glutes back, soft knees

Exercises.Name: Bulgarian Split Squats (or Walking Lunges)
Exercises.FormCue: Front foot planted firmly, drop back knee straight down

Exercises.Name: Seated / Standing Calf Raises
Exercises.FormCue: Full stretch at bottom, 2s pause at top contraction

Exercises.Name: Plank with Shoulder Taps
Exercises.FormCue: Hips level with floor, glutes clenched tight

Days4.DayTitle: Day I: Upper Body Strength (Imperial Push/Pull A)
Days4.Warmup: 5 min dynamic upper mobility & band pull-aparts

Exercises.Name: Barbell Bench Press
Exercises.FormCue: Solid arch, push feet into ground, full range

Exercises.Name: Chest-Supported Row
Exercises.FormCue: Elbows tucked 45 deg, squeeze mid-back

Exercises.Name: Overhead Shoulder Press
Exercises.FormCue: Glutes tight, press bar straight up over head

Exercises.Name: Lat Pulldown (Wide Grip)
Exercises.FormCue: Pull bar to upper collarbone, engage lower traps

Exercises.Name: Superset: Incline Bicep Curls + Triceps Pushdowns
Exercises.FormCue: Strict form, squeeze peak contraction

Days4.DayTitle: Day II: Lower Body Strength (Quads & Posterior Chain A)

Exercises.Name: Barbell Back Squat
Exercises.FormCue: Chest tall, knees driven outward over toes

Exercises.Name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
Exercises.FormCue: Feel deep hamstring stretch, hips push backwards

Exercises.Name: Leg Press / Walking Lunges
Exercises.FormCue: Feet shoulder width, avoid knee lock at peak

Exercises.Name: Standing Calf Raises
Exercises.FormCue: Hold peak contraction for 2 seconds

Exercises.Name: Hanging Leg / Knee Raises
Exercises.FormCue: Initiate movement from abs, avoid swinging

Days4.DayTitle: Day III: Active Recovery & Mobility Walk

Exercises.Name: Outdoor Brisk Walk (8,000 - 10,000 steps)
Exercises.FormCue: Consistent brisk stride, posture upright

Days4.DayTitle: Day IV: Upper Hypertrophy & Arms (Push/Pull B)

Exercises.Name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
Exercises.FormCue: Squeeze pecs at top, control descent

Exercises.Name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
Exercises.FormCue: Pull elbow towards back pocket

Exercises.Name: Dumbbell Lateral Raises
Exercises.FormCue: Light weight, strict form, pause at top

Exercises.Name: Rear Delt Cable Face Pulls
Exercises.FormCue: External rotation at finish point

Exercises.Name: Dumbbell Hammer Curls + Overhead Triceps
Exercises.FormCue: Strict tension on brachialis & long head triceps

HomeBodyweight.Title: Gladiator Bodyweight Foundry (Home Program)
HomeBodyweight.Rationale: Zero-equipment high-tension calisthenics engineered for muscle tone, core stability, and athletic stamina using leverage progressions.

Days3.DayTitle: Day I: Upper Body Calisthenics & Core
Days3.Warmup: 3 min wrist rotations, shoulder taps & jumping jacks

Exercises.Name: Standard Push-Ups (or Incline Push-ups)
Exercises.FormCue: Elbows at 45 degrees, chest touches floor, core solid as plank
Exercises.Regression: Knee Push-ups or Incline (hands on sofa/bed)

Exercises.Name: Pike Push-ups (Shoulder Builder)
Exercises.FormCue: Hips high in inverted V, lower crown of head towards floor

Exercises.Name: Towel / Doorframe Rows (or Under-Table Inverted Rows)
Exercises.FormCue: Grip doorframe or sheet anchored in door, pull chest towards it

Exercises.Name: Chair Tricep Dips
Exercises.FormCue: Back close to chair edge, lower to 90-degree elbows
Exercises.Progression: Legs straight out or elevated on stool

Exercises.Name: Hollow Body Hold / Deadbug
Exercises.FormCue: Lower back glued to floor, engage transverse abdominis

Days3.DayTitle: Day II: Lower Body Power & Glute Pillar
Days3.Warmup: 3 min high knees, hip openers & air squats
Days3.Cooldown: 3 min quad couch stretch & glute figure-4 stretch

Exercises.Name: Tempo Bodyweight Squats (3s down, 1s pause)
Exercises.FormCue: Descend below parallel, push through midfoot, control tempo

Exercises.Name: Walking Lunges / Reverse Lunges
Exercises.FormCue: Torso slightly pitched forward for glute focus, knee grazes ground
Exercises.Progression: Elevated Rear Foot Bulgarian Split Squats

Exercises.Name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
Exercises.FormCue: Drive through heel, hold at peak lock for 2 seconds

Exercises.Name: Calf Raise Burnout (Single Leg on Step)
Exercises.FormCue: Full deep stretch at bottom of stair step

Exercises.Name: Side Plank with Hip Abduction
Exercises.FormCue: Straight line from head to heels, lift top leg steadily

Days3.DayTitle: Day III: Full Body Conditioning & Core Forge

Exercises.Name: Diamond / Close-Grip Push-ups
Exercises.FormCue: Hands form triangle under sternum, tuck elbows

Exercises.Name: Bodyweight Good Mornings / Hamstring Slides
Exercises.FormCue: Hinge at hips with flat back, hands behind head

Exercises.Name: Mountain Climbers (Controlled Tempo)
Exercises.FormCue: Drive knees smoothly to chest without bouncing hips

Exercises.Name: Plank Shoulder Taps
Exercises.FormCue: Feet wide, lock core to prevent rocking hips

WalkingOnly.Title: Centurion Step & Stride Protocol
WalkingOnly.Rationale: Low-impact non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT) for sustainable fat loss, metabolic conditioning, and joint health.

Exercises.Name: Morning Post-Breakfast Walk
Exercises.FormCue: Brisk steady pace (approx 100-110 steps/min), upright posture

Exercises.Name: Evening / Post-Dinner Digestive Walk
Exercises.FormCue: Relaxed steady pace, nose breathing

NoExercise.Title: Nutrition-Centric Foundation Plan
NoExercise.Rationale: 100% of body recomposition in this phase is driven by precise caloric deficit and optimal protein pacing.

Exercises.Name: Daily Incidental Walking Target (6,000 - 8,000 steps)
Exercises.FormCue: Take stairs when possible, 5-min movement breaks every hour of desk work
